title: Robertson panel adopts a policy of ridicule

tellings.quote: you know the Robertson panel in 1953 absolutely adopted this policy of ridicule

plain: In 1953, a government panel led by the scientist Howard P. Robertson, set up to look at UFO reports, took up a policy of mocking the subject, according to Michels. He states this himself, pointing to the panel's report from 1952 to 1953, as a reason UFO reports came to be laughed off in the United States.
